donations.title: Make a donation
donations.info: Give the club something beyond your fee. It is charged through the same gateway you pay receipts with, and you get a downloadable receipt.
donations.notAMember: This account administers the instance and is not a member of the club, so it cannot donate from here.
donations.unavailable: This club is not taking donations at the moment.
donations.raised: Donation recorded. You can pay it now.
donations.awaitingPaymentExplain: We have issued receipt {receipt}. The donation is not made until you pay it, and if you do not, it is voided on its own: nobody will chase you for it.
donations.noGateway: The club has no payment gateway configured yet, so this donation cannot be paid online. Talk to the committee.
